findings.title: Current stock evidence summaries retain unsupported KOH-form and yeast-stock carrier claims
findings.description: The selected payload correctly says ATCC 1775 omits the supplied KOH form and TOGO M2665 supplies Solution classification. The active evidence description still says ATCC1775 uses KOH solution, and the native evidence summary repeats that attribution. ATCC itself only specifies KOH for pH adjustment. A-E-CAPTURE-102 also still calls the JCM1344 yeast stock aqueous although only basal water is specified. Both descriptions are repeated in the saved native evidence summaries, marked context_only rather than historical-invalidated. This does not invalidate the supported preparations or any of the seven Water removals.

findings.bounded_fix: In a new immutable evidence-index/native successor or explicit claim-level supersession, describe ATCC1775 as specifying KOH pH adjustment with supplied form/strength unstated; assign solution classification only to TOGO M2665. Preserve original raw captures, URLs/timestamps, selected payload and unknown carrier. Do not rewrite historical packets or invent an aqueous carrier. For A-E-CAPTURE-102, remove the unsupported aqueous characterization of the case38 stock while preserving the literal 1% label, receiving dose, sterilization and explicit unknown carrier. Preserve the unrelated case27 annotation; no case27 scientific approval is made.
findings.suggested_replacement: ATCC1775 specifies KOH for pH adjustment during trace-element preparation, without stating supplied form, stock strength or carrier. TOGO M2665 separately labels the input as potassium hydroxide solution; that provider classification supports the bounded stock identity.
findings.routing: Reported to worker08 root; independently deduplicated by root/skeptic under W08-W06V4-001. Existing issue1217 residual lineage is the recommended route. No original12 reopening, author correction or GitHub mutation was performed.

members.scientific_assessment: TOGO explicitly labels KOH solusion as Potassium hydroxide solution and assigns the Solution class. The linked ATCC 1775 recipe specifies KOH to dissolve NTA at pH 6.5 and adjust the completed trace preparation to pH 7.0, but does not state the supplied KOH form. The 500 ml initial and 1 L total distilled water belong to that receiving trace preparation. The final payload correctly limits the stock claim to TOGO, retains unquantified KOH, and omits carrier. The active ATCC evidence-description sentence still overattributes solution form and is recorded in the grouped minor provenance finding.

members.scientific_assessment: JCM 1344 specifies 1 ml of 1% Yeast extract solution after cooling the basal medium. The sterilization key says autoclaved or *filter-sterilized, and the yeast entry has no star, supporting the retained autoclaving statement. The basal 935 ml distilled water is not a recipe for the yeast stock. Yeast extract at 1 PERCENT remains literal, without a 10 g/L conversion or an identified commercial extract; omitting Water and retaining UNKNOWN are justified. Active evidence A-E-CAPTURE-102 and its native summary nevertheless still call this stock aqueous, recorded in the grouped minor provenance finding.

findings.suggested_replacement_case38: JCM1344 specifies 1 ml of separately sterilized 1% yeast-extract solution. The stock carrier, extract product and percent basis are unspecified; basal water is not stock-carrier evidence.
